cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Know How to Win This
cards.instruction: Perform mastery of the rules, odds, and consequences while improvising every decision.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I know this board game. I'm opening with the horse in the lake. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There aren't horses. That's the scoring marker.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. I'm testing the scoring environment first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not allowed to move it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We have established a stable scoring environment.

mechanism: A pretends board-game mastery, accepts B corrections and gives B setup control while improvising a new explanation for each action.
confusable: Unlike merely learning openly, A treats each correction as an expected feature of A supposed strategy.
comparison: Scoring marker and legal piece choice differ from shuffled raffle tickets and seller timing.
seedUse: D210-a fake horse and immovable scoring marker; S02-a recruits B to set up legal play while retaining mastery language.
